entities.name: Query protein (315 aa)
observations: Sequence-based assignment: likely ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase (EC 2.7.6.1), supported by reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs at 49.8–52.9% identity and 97.1–98.7% query coverage.
Homolog annotations report Mg2+ as cofactor, with two Mg2+ ions bound per subunit; this is transferred by homology, not directly established for the query.

entities.name: PRPP biosynthesis
observations: Rhea RHEA:15609: D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) + AMP + H+.
